title: Demolition Permit
name: Demolition Permit
description: Demolition permit covering structural surveys, services, asbestos, engineered sequence, stability, exclusion zones and close-out.

sections.title: PRE-DEMOLITION INFORMATION AND SURVEYS
items: Available structural information is reviewed
Structural survey / engineering assessment is complete
Adjacent structures are assessed
Asbestos information suits intrusive demolition
Other hazardous materials are identified
Below-ground and overhead services are identified
Floors / slabs used by plant have adequate capacity

sections.title: SERVICES AND ISOLATIONS
items: All relevant services are identified
Services requiring disconnection are made safe
Isolation / disconnection is verified
Services remaining live are protected
Underground services are included in plant planning

fields.label: Services Remaining Live and Protection Measures
Linked LOTO / Electrical Isolation Permit References

sections.title: ENGINEERED METHOD AND STABILITY
items: Demolition method and sequence are prepared by a competent person
Sequence maintains stability at every stage
Required temporary supports are designed and controlled
Debris and plant loading will not overload structures
Foreseeable collapse remains within controlled boundaries
Method changes require competent review

sections.title: EXCLUSION AND PUBLIC PROTECTION
items: Exclusion and debris zones are defined
Barriers prevent unauthorised entry
Zones account for falling debris and collapse
Plant and pedestrian routes are controlled
Adjacent roads and occupied premises are protected
Scaffold is not used as structural support unless designed

fields.label: Exclusion / Debris Zone Description and Dimensions

sections.title: ENVIRONMENTAL AND EMERGENCY CONTROLS
items: Dust suppression suits the work
Noise and vibration controls are defined
Hot work and fuels are separately controlled
Waste streams are segregated
Run-off and debris are environmentally controlled
Emergency arrangements cover collapse, fire and service strikes

sections.title: AUTHORIZATION AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Current phase matches approved sequence
Structural condition remains suitable
Temporary supports, barriers and isolations are in place
Weather is suitable
Team is briefed on sequence and emergency arrangements
Work stops at a stable condition
Remaining structure and area are inspected
